verdicts.reason: A is cramped. 'WEEKEND ONLY' is jammed against the left edge, set inline with the headline and reading as a stray fragment. The Shop Sale button is squeezed in beside the body copy and almost touches the bottom edge. The bottle runs nearly to the bottom with no margin. B reads cleanly left to right with even margins and a well-placed CTA, but it has clear flaws. The '20% off' headline sits low and is disconnected from the eyebrow above it, the body copy floats top-aligned rather than sharing the headline's baseline, and the peach circle has shrunk to a cropped dot in the corner.
